classification: Literal source excerpts for a repeated NPC handoff and its real chain. Source hashes and complete provider prerequisites retained; no reward or kill amount is supplied.

directives.text: Don't accept the other quests yet
Run circles around The Shimmering Flats until all objectives are complete
Kill Salt Flats Scavengers and Salt Flats Vultures. Loot them for their Bones
Kill Sparkleshell Tortoises, Sparkleshell Borers and Sparkleshell Snappers. Loot them for their Shells
Don't go out of your way to collect all Turtle Meat
Kill Scorpid Reavers and Scorpid Terrors. Loot them for their Venom
Kill Saltstone Basilisks, Saltstone Crystalhides and Saltstone Gazers
Loot Saltstone Basilisks for their Scales
Open the Rocket Car Rubble. Loot it for the Rocket Car Parts
Turn in Delivery to the Gnomes
Talk to Krazek upstairs on the top floor
Talk to Kebok and Krazek up stairs on the top floor
Accept Dream Dust in the Swamp
Kill Adolescent Whelps and Dreaming Whelps. Loot them for their Specks of Dream Dust
You won't find enough Whelps to finish this quest in 1 pass, so continue with other quests
Turn in Dream Dust in the Swamp

objectiveText: Go to the Howling Vale and study the Tome of Mel'Thandris, then return to Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow at Forest Song.
Speak with Thyn'tel Bladeweaver at the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus.
Search through Velinde's chest for her journal, then return it along with the key to Thyn'tel Bladeweaver in Darnassus.
Speak with Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet.
Take a boat to Booty Bay and speak with Caravaneer Ruzzgot.
Bring 30 Rocket Car Parts to Kravel Koalbeard in the Shimmering Flats.
Bring Kravel's Parts Order to Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet.
Bring Kravel's Parts to Kravel Koalbeard in the Shimmering Flats.
Bring the Delicate Car Parts to Fizzle Brassbolts in Shimmering Flats.
Talk to Krazek in Booty Bay.
Bring 10 Specks of Dream Dust to Krazek in Booty Bay. Dream Dust is gathered from the dragon whelps of the Swamp of Sorrows.
